prompts.name: P51D
prompts.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: realistic aircraft reference image for the Pacific Fighter Sweep simulator. Create one high-resolution landscape aviation photograph of P-51D Mustang, natural aluminum with olive drab upper rear fuselage, yellow engine cowling and spinner, black and white invasion stripes, US star and bars, bubble canopy, FOUR propeller blades. Long slender inline-engine cowling with smoothly integrated pointed spinner and subtle chin air inlet; six individual exhaust stacks each side. Entire aircraft in frame, parked with landing gear down on a quiet airfield apron, front three-quarter view from slightly above wing height to clearly show the nose, wings and tail. Physically believable proportions, authentic riveted metal panels, restrained weathering, realistic glass reflections and rubber tires. Soft clear daylight, neutral distant hangars and sky, subtle depth of field. Aircraft fills frame with comfortable margins. No people, no caption, no watermark. Prioritize accurate airframe anatomy, clean joined nose contours and propeller alignment; no cartoon shapes, no bulbous detached ball noses. This is an original historically inspired visualization, not a blueprint.
